USE WAREHOUSE team_f_wh;
WITH group_totals AS (
  SELECT REGION, COUNT(*) AS group_total
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE REGION IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY REGION
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
),
cat_counts AS (
  SELECT t.REGION, t.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1,
         COUNT(*) AS cat_count,
         g.group_total
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2 t
  JOIN group_totals g ON t.REGION = g.REGION
  WHERE t.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.REGION, t.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, g.group_total
),
with_pct AS (
  SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * cat_count / group_total, 2) AS pct FROM cat_counts
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS valid_questions,
       MIN(pct) AS min_pct, MAX(pct) AS max_pct, ROUND(AVG(pct),2) AS avg_pct
FROM with_pct WHERE pct BETWEEN 5 AND 95
